blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Second seed Filipino Alexandra Eala defeated Croatian Antonia Ruzic, 7-6 (7), 7-5, Friday night to reach the WTA 250 Prudential Hong Kong Open semifinals at Victoria Park Tennis Stadium outdoor hardcourt. Eala was up, 4-3, in the second set when play was suspended due to rain. When play resumed, Ruzic grabbed the lead at 5-4 but Eala fought back, winning the next two games to secure the match after two hours and 30 minutes.
